strings.settings.saved_restart: Preferences saved. Restart SalixTorrent to apply the selected language everywhere.

strings.settings.seeding_defaults_note: Used as the default for new torrents. Existing torrents keep their own seeding goal unless the option below is selected.

strings.view.application_menu.application_data_f:
Application data folder

Opens SalixTorrent's persistent state directory containing files such as settings.json, session.json, cached .torrent metadata and ui_errors.log. This is separate from payload downloads.
strings.view.application_menu.core_capabilities_:
Core capabilities
  - HTTP/UDP trackers with batched scrape statistics, DHT, PEX and LAN discovery
  - Multi-peer downloading and seeding
  - Fast resume and SHA-1 piece verification
  - Magnet metadata exchange (BEP-9)
  - Multi-file torrents and torrent creation
  - Queue/file priorities and bandwidth controls
  - UPnP/NAT-PMP connectivity support
strings.view.application_menu.ctrl_o_open_torren:
Ctrl+O    Open .torrent file
Ctrl+M    Open magnet link
Ctrl+N    Create torrent
Ctrl+F    Find/filter torrents
Ctrl+,    Preferences
Ctrl+1    Active Transfers
Ctrl+2    Create Torrent
Ctrl+3    Preferences
F1        Help Topics
strings.view.application_menu.glossary_a_z_jumps:
Glossary A-Z

Jumps directly to the alphabetized technical glossary inside Help Topics.
strings.view.application_menu.help_topics_opens_:
Help Topics

Opens SalixTorrent's built-in CHM-style manual: subjects on the left, detailed explanations on the right, searchable contents, and an A-Z glossary generated from the same definitions used by hover tooltips.
strings.view.application_menu.pause_all_requests:
Pause All

Requests a paused state for every currently active torrent without removing them or deleting data.
strings.view.application_menu.resume_all_request:
Resume All

Requests that paused/eligible torrents become active again, still respecting the configured active-download slot limit and queue priorities.
strings.view.application_menu.the_same_commands_: The same commands are available from the traditional application menu.
strings.view.create_torrent_view.added_to_active: Added to Active Transfers - verifying source for seeding
strings.view.create_torrent_view.cancel_torrent_:
Cancel torrent creation

Requests cancellation of the background hashing job. SalixTorrent does not replace the chosen output with a half-written .torrent file.
strings.view.create_torrent_view.choose_where_to: Choose where to save the .torrent file.
strings.view.create_torrent_view.create_a_bittor: Create a BitTorrent v1, v2, or hybrid .torrent from a file, archive, or folder.
strings.view.create_torrent_view.files_such_as_z: Files such as .zip, .7z and .iso are normal single-file torrents.
strings.view.create_torrent_view.folder_selected: Folder selected - files are scanned and hashed in the background when creation starts.
strings.view.create_torrent_view.one_tracker_url: One tracker URL per line. Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored.
strings.view.create_torrent_view.optional_commen: Optional comment stored in the .torrent metadata
strings.view.create_torrent_view.select_file_or_: Select File or Archive to Torrent
strings.view.create_torrent_view.selected_source:
Selected source path

This is the file or folder whose bytes will be hashed into the new torrent. Torrent creation reads this source; it does not modify or move it.
strings.view.create_torrent_view.source_is_seede:
Source is seeded in place (no copy to downloads):
{created_source_path}
strings.view.create_torrent_view.source_summary_:
Source summary

Describes whether the current source will become a single-file or multi-file torrent and, when known, its payload size. The source itself remains untouched during torrent creation.
strings.view.create_torrent_view.value_value_val:
{torrent_name} | {mode} | {file_count:,} file(s) | {value3:,.2f} MiB | {piece_count:,} pieces @ {value5} | {generation} | Info Hash: {info_hash}{skipped}
Saved: {output_path}
strings.view.download_view.cancel_recheck_closes:
Cancel recheck

Closes this confirmation window without invalidating fast-resume state or starting a verification pass.
strings.view.download_view.cancel_removal_closes:
Cancel removal

Closes this confirmation window without changing the torrent, payload, resume data or queue.
strings.view.download_view.clear_filters_removes:
Clear filters

Removes the torrent-name search and status filter. This changes only what is visible in the queue and never changes transfer state.
strings.view.download_view.client_id_the_peer_id:
Client ID

The peer identity prefix SalixTorrent presents during BitTorrent handshakes. Remote clients can use peer IDs and extension metadata to identify the software they are connected to.
strings.view.download_view.current_seeding_goal_: Current: {goal_text}. Changes apply only to this torrent and persist across restart. Applying a timed goal starts its countdown from now.
strings.view.download_view.down_up_the_selected_:
Down / Up

The selected display unit is used for both the torrent's current download and upload rates. Right-click a torrent row to change Transfer Rate Units.
strings.view.download_view.error_notice_when_sal:
Error / Notice

When SalixTorrent encounters a recoverable problem, the human-readable reason appears here. Use it to understand what failed before choosing Retry.
strings.view.download_view.files_per_file_verifi:
Files

Per-file verified progress, storage paths and selective-download priority controls for the selected torrent.
strings.view.download_view.general_overall_trans:
General

Overall transfer, swarm, connectivity and torrent metadata for the selected torrent.
strings.view.download_view.ip_families_peers_ipv: IP Families: peers IPv4 {ipv4_peers} / IPv6 {ipv6_peers} | DHT UDP IPv4 {value2} / IPv6 {value3}
strings.view.download_view.name: Name
strings.view.download_view.name_the_torrent_payl:
Name

The torrent payload name. Click a column header to sort the visible table; click a row to select it. Right-click any row cell for torrent actions.
strings.view.download_view.network_path_any_inte: Network Path: Any interface (system routing) | Lock off
strings.view.download_view.paste_a_bittorrent_v1: Paste a BitTorrent v1 magnet link. SalixTorrent will discover peers through its trackers, DHT and LAN, then retrieve BEP-9 metadata.
strings.view.download_view.paste_a_magnet_link_t: Paste a magnet link to begin.
strings.view.download_view.paste_magnet_link_cop:
Paste magnet link

Copies the current clipboard text into the magnet field. SalixTorrent does not begin network activity until Add Magnet is pressed.
strings.view.download_view.payload_size_total_si:
Payload size

Total size described by this torrent's metadata, not the size of the .torrent file itself.
strings.view.download_view.peers_live_bittorrent:
Peers

Live BitTorrent peer connections: client identity, discovery source, direction, piece completion, per-peer rates and protocol state.
strings.view.download_view.pieces_a_compact_map_:
Pieces

A compact map and focused table showing piece verification, requests, blocks and current swarm availability.
strings.view.download_view.progress_verified_com:
Progress

Verified completion of the torrent payload. During selective downloading, the selected-files completion state can finish before the full torrent reaches 100%.
strings.view.download_view.remove_external_seed_:
Remove from SalixTorrent removes the transfer from the queue and leaves the original seed source untouched.

Remove + Delete Data only deletes SalixTorrent-managed data under the downloads folder and resume metadata. The external seed source and your original .torrent file are NEVER deleted.
strings.view.download_view.remove_managed_data_e:
Remove from SalixTorrent removes the transfer from the queue but keeps downloaded data on disk.

Remove + Delete Data permanently deletes the downloaded payload and its SalixTorrent resume metadata. Your original .torrent file is NOT deleted.
strings.view.download_view.seeding_goal_saved_fo: Seeding goal saved for this torrent.
strings.view.download_view.selected_torrent_this:
Selected torrent

This inspector and the detail tabs below always describe the torrent currently selected in the transfer queue.
strings.view.download_view.size_total_payload_si:
Size

Total payload size described by the torrent metadata. This is not the size of the .torrent metadata file itself.
strings.view.download_view.sources_trackers_dht_:
Sources

Trackers, DHT, PEX and Local Peer Discovery with live status and discovery diagnostics.
strings.view.download_view.speed_rolling_downloa:
Speed

Rolling download/upload history, recent averages, peaks and transfer-limit reference lines.
strings.view.download_view.swarm_status_how_the_:
Swarm status

How the selected torrent is participating in the BitTorrent swarm: lifecycle state, discovery, peers, availability, connectivity and storage mode.
strings.view.download_view.the_torrent_was_remov:
The torrent was removed from SalixTorrent, but downloaded-data cleanup was not fully completed:

{cleanup_error}
strings.view.download_view.this_discards_salixto: This discards SalixTorrent's fast-resume trust and SHA-1 checks the existing payload again. No downloaded data is deleted. An active torrent will resume automatically after a successful recheck.
strings.view.download_view.torrent_metadata_desc:
Torrent metadata

Descriptive and protocol metadata read from the .torrent or resolved magnet, plus the local storage and cached metadata paths used by SalixTorrent.
strings.view.download_view.torrent_row_click_to_:
Torrent row

Click to select this torrent and populate the inspector below. Right-click any cell in this row for queue, transfer, recheck, copy, properties and removal actions.
strings.view.download_view.transfer_metrics_live:
Transfer metrics

Live payload rates, byte totals, remaining data, ETA, elapsed active time, share ratio and current connected-peer count for the selected torrent.
strings.view.download_view.value_downloaded_valu: {state}. Downloaded {downloaded}. You can open the payload folder now or dismiss this notice.
strings.view.download_view.value_selected_files_: {value0:.2f}% Selected Files Complete ({value1} / {value2} Wanted Pieces) - {value3:.2f}% of full torrent
strings.view.file_view.external_seed_priority_di: External seed source is read-only; file priorities are disabled while seeding it.
strings.view.file_view.file_relative_payload_pat:
File

Relative payload path described by the torrent. Right-click a file row to change selective-download priority.
strings.view.file_view.file_size_payload_bytes_a:
File size

Payload bytes assigned to this file by the torrent metadata.
strings.view.file_view.files_select_a_torrent_to: Files: select a torrent to inspect payload files
strings.view.file_view.files_view_shows_the_sele:
Files view

Shows the selected torrent's real payload files, SHA-1-verified progress and selective-download priorities. BitTorrent pieces can cross file boundaries, so file progress is derived from verified piece coverage rather than only file length on disk.
strings.view.file_view.priority_boundary_note: Right-click a file to set priority. Boundary pieces shared with a wanted file may still write a small amount into a skipped neighbouring file.
strings.view.file_view.right_click_a_file_to_set: Right-click a file to set High, Normal, Low, or Don't Download.
strings.view.file_view.showing_value_of_value_fi: Showing {displayed_count:,} of {file_count:,} files. Right-click a file to set priority. Don't Download skips pieces used only by skipped files.
strings.view.help_topics_view.clear_help_search_:
Clear help search

Restores the complete Contents and Glossary A-Z lists.
strings.view.help_topics_view.glossary_a_z_alpha:
Glossary A-Z

Alphabetical index generated from the same definitions used by SalixTorrent's contextual hover help.
strings.view.help_topics_view.help_contents_the_:
Help Contents

The main SalixTorrent manual arranged by subject, similar to the Contents pane in traditional Windows CHM help files.
strings.view.help_topics_view.help_search_filter:
Help search

Filters both the subject list and the A-Z glossary. Search by full words, acronyms such as DHT/PEX/LPD, or concepts such as port mapping, pieces, privacy or magnet links.
strings.view.peer_view.flags_i_we_are_interested: Flags: I = we are interested | i = peer interested | C = peer chokes us | c = we choke peer
strings.view.peer_view.peers_0_connected_ipv4_0_: Peers: 0 connected | IPv4: 0 | IPv6: 0 | MSE/RC4: 0 | Plaintext: 0 | Policy: {policy} | Torrent state: {state_label} - waiting for peer connections
strings.view.peer_view.peers_select_a_torrent_to: Peers: select a torrent to inspect its connections
strings.view.peer_view.peers_value_connected_ipv: Peers: {connected} connected | IPv4: {ipv4_count} | IPv6: {ipv6_count} | MSE/RC4: {encrypted} | Plaintext: {plaintext} | Policy: {policy} | Torrent state: {state_label}
strings.view.piece_view.details_active_pieces_an: DETAILS - active pieces and the next incomplete range
strings.view.piece_view.disk_i_o_writer_idle_buf: Disk I/O: writer idle | buffer 0 B | recent-piece cache 0 B
strings.view.piece_view.disk_i_o_writer_value_bu: Disk I/O: writer {writer_label} | buffer {value1} / {value2} ({pending_writes} pending) | avg write {average_ms:.2f} ms | backpressure {pressure_events} | cache {value6} / {value7} ({cache_hits} hit / {cache_misses} miss)
strings.view.piece_view.focused_piece_details_to:
Focused piece details

To keep the interface responsive on torrents with thousands of pieces, SalixTorrent shows active/requested pieces plus useful nearby incomplete context rather than continuously rendering every piece as a table row.
strings.view.piece_view.map_verified_downloading: Map: Verified | Downloading | Requested | Mixed | Missing | No known source
strings.view.piece_view.piece_map_value_cells_on: Piece Map: {cell_count:,} cells - one cell per piece
strings.view.piece_view.piece_map_value_cells_up: Piece Map: {cell_count:,} cells - up to {pieces_per_cell:,} pieces per cell (large torrents are compacted for performance)
strings.view.piece_view.piece_map_waiting_for_to: Piece map waiting for torrent telemetry
strings.view.piece_view.piece_progress_how_much_:
Piece progress

How much of this piece's block payload has arrived. A piece at 100% is not trusted until its SHA-1 hash passes verification.
strings.view.piece_view.pieces_select_a_torrent_: Pieces: select a torrent to inspect piece state
strings.view.piece_view.pieces_value_value_verif: Pieces: {verified:,} / {total:,} verified | {downloading:,} downloading | {requested:,} requested | {missing:,} missing | Availability: {availability:.2f}
strings.view.piece_view.scheduler_rarest_first_p: Scheduler: Rarest-first | Pipeline: adaptive | Endgame: Standby

Scheduler: Rarest-first | Pipeline: {pipeline_label} | Timeout: {timeout_label} | Endgame: {endgame_label} | Remaining blocks: {remaining_blocks:,} | Outstanding: {outstanding:,} ({duplicates:,} duplicate)
strings.view.settings_view.aggregate_limit_share: Aggregate limit shared by every active torrent. 0 = Unlimited.
strings.view.settings_view.binding_chooses_one_l: Binding chooses one local IPv4 or IPv6 source address for torrent traffic. Any interface uses both families when the operating system provides them. Interface Lock additionally monitors the selected address and stops torrent networking immediately if it disappears.
strings.view.settings_view.external_ipv6_route_f: External: IPv6 route/firewall dependent; no IPv4 NAT mapping
strings.view.settings_view.interface_lock_kill_s: Interface Lock / kill switch (fail closed if the selected address disappears)
strings.view.settings_view.ipv6_direct_value_act: IPv6 Direct ({listener_count} active listener ports; IPv4 NAT mapping not applicable)
strings.view.settings_view.listen_port_fallback_:
Listen-port fallback

If the preferred TCP port is already occupied, SalixTorrent tries the next ten port numbers rather than failing the entire torrent subsystem.
strings.view.settings_view.mapped_means_the_rout: 'Mapped' means the router accepted a mapping. 'Incoming Confirmed' means a real remote peer has reached SalixTorrent.
strings.view.settings_view.mask_peer_ip_addresse: Mask peer IP addresses in the interface
strings.view.settings_view.per_torrent_limits_as: Per-torrent limits assigned when a torrent is added.
strings.view.settings_view.restore_defaults_repl:
Restore Defaults

Replaces the current application preferences with SalixTorrent's built-in defaults and applies them. This does not delete torrents or payload data.
strings.view.settings_view.resume_torrents_that_: Resume torrents that were active when SalixTorrent closed
strings.view.settings_view.save_preferences_vali:
Save Preferences

Validates, persists and applies the values shown on this page. Networking toggles and global limits can affect active sessions immediately.
strings.view.source_view.discovery_sources_are_i: Discovery sources are independent. Waiting is neutral; Timeout is a warning for that source, not a torrent failure, while other trackers/DHT/PEX/LAN continue.
strings.view.source_view.sources_select_a_torren: Sources: select a torrent to inspect peer discovery
strings.view.source_view.sources_value_tracker_s: Sources: {tracker_count} tracker(s) + DHT + PEX + LAN | Responding: {active_count} | Pending: {pending_count} | Warnings: {warning_count} | Errors: {error_count} | Scrape A/P/W/E: {scrape_active}/{scrape_pending}/{scrape_warnings}/{scrape_errors} | Peers seen - Tracker {tracker_peers} | DHT {dht_peers} | PEX {pex_peers} | LAN {lan_peers}
strings.view.speed_view.2_minute_average_down_va: 2-minute average: Down {value0} | Up {value1}   Peak: Down {value2} | Up {value3}
strings.view.speed_view.average_down_0_0_kb_s_up: Average: Down 0.0 KB/s | Up 0.0 KB/s   Peak: Down 0.0 KB/s | Up 0.0 KB/s
strings.view.speed_view.download_history_measure:
Download history

Measured payload download rate for the selected torrent across the visible time window.
strings.view.speed_view.download_limit_line_refe:
Download limit line

Reference line showing the selected torrent's configured download ceiling when one is active. The global shared limit is reported in the text summary above.
strings.view.speed_view.rolling_session_history_: Rolling session history sampled every 0.5 seconds. History resets when SalixTorrent restarts.
strings.view.speed_view.speed_select_a_torrent_t: Speed: select a torrent to inspect transfer history
strings.view.speed_view.time_axis_the_graph_runs:
Time axis

The graph runs from older samples on the left toward the current moment at 0 seconds on the right.
strings.view.speed_view.upload_history_measured_:
Upload history

Measured payload upload rate for the selected torrent across the visible time window. Upload can occur while downloading as soon as verified pieces are available.
strings.view.speed_view.upload_limit_line_refere:
Upload limit line

Reference line showing the selected torrent's configured upload ceiling when one is active. The global shared limit is reported in the text summary above.
